**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user has a Nikon D850 camera, which they have had for about a year and a half.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for a backup camera body to complement their current Nikon D850.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering the Nikon Z6 for its video capabilities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Nikon Z6 can record 4K UHD (3840 x 2160) video at 30p, 25p, and 24p, with a maximum bitrate of 100 Mbps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6 can also record 1080p at up to 120p for slow-motion footage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The D850 can record 4K UHD at 30p in a cropped mode (DX mode) and is limited to 1080p at 60p in full-frame mode.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6 has in-body image stabilization (IBIS) providing up to 5 stops of stabilization, while the D850 relies on lens-based stabilization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6 features advanced autofocus with 273 phase-detection points, covering 90% of the frame, compared to the D850's 153-point system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6 has a faster readout speed, reducing rolling shutter artifacts, and a more effective moiré reduction system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both cameras offer zebra stripes, focus peaking, and timecode support; the Z6 has a built-in interval timer for 4K time-lapses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6 has a more advanced audio system with a built-in stereo microphone and an external microphone option via a 3.5mm jack.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6 is a more capable video camera than the D850, with advanced autofocus, better image stabilization, and reduced rolling shutter artifacts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use their Sigma 24-70mm f/2.8 DG OS HSM Art Lens on the Z6 with the FTZ Adapter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The FTZ Adapter allows for electronic aperture control and supports phase-detection autofocus, but IBIS will not be available when using the adapter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Z6's autofocus performance might be slightly slower and less accurate with the FTZ Adapter compared to native Z-mount lenses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user is considering the D500 and D5 as alternative backup camera options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The D500 shares the same mount and lens ecosystem as the D850, has an excellent autofocus system, but has
